recommendations.claude-fable-5-1: Freeze a written block-scoped grammar (tags on their own lines, exact byte equality for values, no normalization, unknown keys inside the block disallowed or explicitly ignored) before execution, replace the duplicate C10 with a formatting-edge case, and pre-register that C05 is the discriminating case between the conservative and source-adapter paths.
recommendations.grok-4.6: Do not execute the 24-call experiment; lock a formal observed-block grammar, drop or replace the C01/C10 duplicate, add malformed-fence and in-block extra-key cases, and score both deterministic paths against a written oracle rather than this council.
recommendations.qwen3-coder: Reject the current labeling policy and experimental setup; revise to allow for robust handling of ambiguous or malformed source data and ensure true independence of evaluation.
